transitions.historical_text: "Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"As long as this card remains face-up on the field, other monsters cannot change their battle positions or attack. Select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card (this effect can only be used once per turn and you can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card). The ATK and DEF of this card become the same amounts as the monster equipped to this card. If this card is destroyed as a result of battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead.
transitions.summary: Era stat-copy semantics for Trap Monsters: the GOAT script's ATK/DEF value functions drop the modern guard `g:GetFirst():GetOriginalType()&TYPE_MONSTER==0`, so an equipped card whose original type is not Monster (a Trap Monster such as Embodiment of Apophis) still hands Thousand-Eyes Restrict its printed ATK/DEF, whereas the modern script returns 0 in that case. Upstream states this directly in its annotation ('Gains stats of trap monsters as well'). No English printing distinguishes Trap Monsters, so this is a period interpretation rather than an erratum, and its chronology is unresolved.

effective.basis: TCG release of LED2-EN005 (Legendary Duelists: Ancient Millennium), the first printing carrying the final wording

transitions.modern_text: "Relinquished" + "Thousand-Eyes Idol"Other monsters on the field cannot change their battle positions or attack. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.
transitions.summary: Wording modernisation only across v4 (RP02-EN021, 2009) condensing the equip clause, v5 (Legendary Collection) 'declare an attack', v6 (DPRP-EN046) PSCT colons plus 'target 1 monster ... equip that target', and v7 (LED2-EN005) '(max. 1)' and 'ATK/DEF'. The script diff carries no EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET difference, so the PSCT 'target' wording did not change targeting, and the once-per-turn equip and the battle-destruction substitution resolve identically throughout.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v3 (MC1-EN004, 2004-12-01), which the goat cdb text matches at ratio 0.999; v2 (DB1-EN195, 2004-10-12) differs from it only by the capitalisation of 'Battle Positions'. Earlier versions v0/v1 (PSV-084 / PSV-E084, 2002-10-20) carry the original 'take on the ATK and DEF ... a face-down monster results in an ATK and DEF of 0' phrasing and predate the baseline implementation's era, so they are not recorded as changes. The remaining hunks of the script diff are non-behavioural: `|` vs `+` in SetReset, a double space in the equip operation condition. The only implementation-relevant difference is the Trap Monster stat copy, and nothing in the packet or the shared briefs dates when the modern reading took over, so the change is recorded with no chronology rather than guessed.
